title: headwater-validate/2
description: What `headwater validate --json` prints: every error and warning of a database or a study on its background. Example: `headwater validate project/tshirt-footprint --json`.

kind.description: `database` or `study`, or null for a folder that did not read.

valid.description: True when there is no error.

release.description: `name@hash` of the release, or null for a folder of process files.

folder.description: The folder of process files, or null for a release.

background.description: Null for a folder that did not read.

method.description: Null for a folder that did not read, and for several methods used together, whose joined id is not written to a file: `methods` lists their ids.

methods.description: The id of each method used. Null for a folder that did not read.

code.description: Stable, so tools can match on it: `supplier-not-found`.

item.description: What is wrong: `tshirt:tshirt line e02`, or `flow toy:n2o`.

location.description: A file and a row, when known: `exchanges.csv:3`.

text.description: The line `validate` prints: item, message, and the location in brackets.
